byte_hex n:i > t

le64 n:i > t

let v first state64

elf_with_buffer payload:t writable:i > t

let extended > writable 0
let header_size if extended 232 176
if (and extended (> (+ header_size (bytes_in payload)) 2097152)) fail "native_segment_range"

sources.fold_i64.tide:
use rule_scan

integer_value token:t > i
need (int token) "expected_i64_literal" 5

reject_line reason:t line:i > t
need (nil t) reason line

fold_bindings header:*t expr:*t > {FoldNames}
if not eq length header 5 fail "expected_fold_parameters"
if (< (length expr) 7) fail "expected_i64_fold"
if not and (text_eq (word header 3) ">") (text_eq (word header 4) "i") fail "expected_i64_result"
if not and (text_eq (word header 1) (concat (word expr 2) ":i"))
           (text_eq (word header 2) (concat (word expr 1) ":*i")) fail "expected_fold_parameters"
if not (text_eq (word expr 0) "fold") fail "expected_fold_body"
make FoldNames seed (word expr 2) acc (word expr 3) row_name (word expr 4) item (word expr 5)

direct_opcode expr:*t > ?t
if not (eq (length expr) 9) (nil t)
if not (and (text_eq (word expr 7) (word expr 3)) (text_eq (word expr 8) (word expr 5))) (nil t)
let op word expr 6
if text_eq op "+" (some "480306") if text_eq op "-" (some "482b06") if text_eq op "*" (some "480faf06") (nil t)

fold_opcode header:*t expr:*t > t
let bindings fold_bindings header expr
need (direct_opcode expr) "unsupported_fold_operator" 2

emit_fold opcode:t initial:i count:i data:t > t
let output print_integer
let advance "4883c608ffc9"
let overflow_jump + (bytes_in advance) (+ 2 bytes_in output)
if > overflow_jump 127 fail "short_branch_range"
let checked_op concat opcode (concat "70" (byte_hex overflow_jump))
let loop_code back_if "75" (concat checked_op advance)
let tail concat "85c9" (concat (skip_if "74" loop_code) (concat output overflow_error))
let setup concat "48b8" (concat (le64 initial) (concat "b9" (le32 count)))
elf_image (concat setup (concat "488d35" (concat (le32 bytes_in tail) (concat tail data))))

record Literals
initial:i count:i data:t

literal_inputs name:t args:*t line:i > {Literals}
if (< (length args) 5) (need (nil {Literals}) "expected_literal_list_call" line)
let grouped text_eq (word args 2) "("
let pos if grouped 3 2
let stop - (length args) (if grouped 1 0)
if (and grouped (not (text_eq (word args stop) ")"))) fail "invalid_list_group"
if not (and (text_eq (word args 0) name) (and (text_eq (word args pos) "list") (text_eq (word args (+ pos 1)) "i")))
  (need (nil {Literals}) "expected_literal_list_call" line)
let count need (int (word args (+ pos 2))) "expected_i64_literal" line
let start + pos 3
if (not (eq count (- stop start))) (need (nil {Literals}) "wrong_list_length" line)
let data fold args "" acc row token
  if (and (> row start) (not (> row stop))) (concat acc (le64 (need (int token) "expected_i64_literal" line))) acc
make Literals initial (need (int (word args 1)) "expected_i64_literal" line) count count data data

literal_call name:t opcode:t args:*t > t
let values literal_inputs name args 5
emit_fold opcode (get initial values) (get count values) (get data values)

example_block decl:{Declaration} > b
and (text_eq (word (words (get header decl)) 0) "example")
  (and (eq (length (get body decl)) 1) (text_eq (text_slice (word (get body decl) 0) 0 1) "{"))

step_nodes expr:*t > i
fold expr 0 n pos token
  + n (if (and (> pos 6) (not (or (text_eq token "(") (text_eq token ")")))) 1 0)

bounded_work expr:*t count:i > b
not (> (+ 6 (+ count (* count (step_nodes expr)))) 100000)

closed_program blocks:*{Declaration} repetitions:i > t
let func need (at blocks 0) "expected_fold_and_main" 1
let entry need (at blocks 1) "expected_fold_and_main" 1
let header words (get header func)
let expr body_words func
let names fold_bindings header expr
let sig words (get header entry)
if (not (and (eq (length sig) 3) (and (text_eq (word sig 0) "main") (and (text_eq (word sig 1) ">") (text_eq (word sig 2) "i"))))) fail "expected_main"
if not (fold blocks true ok row decl and ok (if (< row 3) true (example_block decl))) fail "unsupported_declaration"
let values literal_inputs (word header 0) (body_words entry) (+ (get line entry) 1)
if not (bounded_work expr (get count values)) fail "native_work_bound"
case (if (eq repetitions 1) (direct_opcode expr) (nil t))
  (scalar_image (scalar_step expr 6 names) (get initial values) (get count values) (get data values) repetitions)
  opcode (emit_fold opcode (get initial values) (get count values) (get data values))

argument_program blocks:*{Declaration} entry:{Declaration} > t
let sig words (get header entry)
if (not (eq (length sig) 5)) fail "expected_i64_list_entry"
if (not (and (text_eq (word sig 3) ">") (text_eq (word sig 4) "i"))) fail "expected_i64_list_entry"
let body body_words entry
let direct text_eq (word body 0) "fold"
if (and (not direct) (not (and (eq (length body) 3)
     (and (text_eq (word sig 1) (concat (word body 1) ":i"))
          (text_eq (word sig 2) (concat (word body 2) ":*i")))))) fail "expected_forwarded_parameters"
let target if direct entry (find_declaration blocks (word body 0))
let expr if direct body (body_words target)
let names fold_bindings (words (get header target)) expr
let setup_cost if direct 3 6
let metered > (+ setup_cost (* 4096 (step_nodes expr))) 100000
argv_image (scalar_step_mode expr 6 names metered) metered setup_cost

build_entry blocks:*{Declaration} entry:t > t
let target find_declaration blocks entry
let sig words (get header target)
let result word sig (- (length sig) 1)
if (or (text_eq result "*b") (text_eq result "*i")) (scan_program blocks target)
if (and (text_eq entry "main") (eq (length sig) 3))
  (closed_program blocks 1) (argument_program blocks target)

compile_repeated source:t repetitions:i > t
closed_program (declarations source) repetitions

compile source:t > t
build_entry (declarations source) "main"

compile_entry source:r entry:t > t
build_entry (declarations (read source)) entry

main source:r > t
compile read source

let ch text_slice line (- pos 1) pos
concat acc (if or (text_eq ch " ") (text_eq ch "\t") "\n"
  (if (or (text_eq ch "(") (or (text_eq ch ")") (or (text_eq ch ",") (text_eq ch "=")))) (concat "\n" (concat ch "\n")) ch))
fold (lines separated) (list t 0) items row token

record Declaration

record ProgramRows

finish_rows builder:{ProgramRows} > {ProgramRows}

make ProgramRows complete (append (get complete builder) decl) current (nil {Declaration})

blank_line line:t > b

let first_char text_slice line 0 1
if (not (or (text_eq first_char " ") (text_eq first_char "\t"))) false
eq (length (words line)) 0

declarations source:t > *{Declaration}
let start make ProgramRows complete (list {Declaration} 0) current (nil {Declaration})
let end_rows fold (lines source) start builder row line
  if (blank_line line) (finish_rows builder)
  let decl case (get current builder) (make Declaration line row header line body (list t 0)) cur
    (with body cur (append (get body cur) line))
  with current builder (some decl)
get complete (finish_rows end_rows)

body_words decl:{Declaration} > *t
let tokens fold (get body decl) (list t 0) all row line
  fold (words line) all result pos token append result token
if (not (text_eq (word tokens 0) "(")) tokens
let size length tokens
if (not (text_eq (word tokens (- size 1)) ")")) fail "open_expression_group"
fold tokens (list t 0) inner pos token if (and (> pos 1) (< pos size)) (append inner token) inner

  if (text_eq (word (words (get header decl)) 0) name)
    (case previous (some decl) duplicate (fail "ambiguous_native_entry")) previous

sources.rule_scan.tide:
use scan_image

use source

record StateSlot
name:t kind:t initial:t offset:i

record RuleProgram
fields:i code:{ScanCode}

word_range tokens:*t start:i stop:i > *t
fold tokens (list t 0) result row token
  if (and (> row start) (not (> row stop))) (append result token) result

scalar_type kind:t > t
if (or (text_eq kind "i") (text_eq kind "b")) kind (fail "expected_native_scalar")

typed_name declaration:t > &tt
let pos need (text_find declaration ":" 0) "expected_typed_name" 0
pair (text_slice declaration 0 pos) (text_slice declaration (+ pos 1) (text_len declaration))

literal_bits kind:t token:t > t
if (text_eq kind "b")
  (if (text_eq token "true") (le64 1) (if (text_eq token "false") (le64 0) (fail "expected_bool_literal")))
le64 (need (int token) "expected_i64_literal" 0)

state_slots tokens:*t > *{StateSlot}
if (not (and (text_eq (word tokens 0) "state") (and (> (length tokens) 1) (eq (mod (- (length tokens) 1) 3) 0)))) fail "expected_state_fields"
fold tokens (list {StateSlot} 0) slots row token
  if (not (eq (mod row 3) 2)) slots
  let field typed_name token
  let kind scalar_type (second field)
  if (not (text_eq (word tokens row) "=")) fail "expected_state_initializer"
  append slots (make StateSlot name (first field) kind kind initial (concat "48b8" (literal_bits kind (word tokens (+ row 1)))) offset (* 8 (length slots)))

state_load field:{StateSlot} > t
concat "498b87" (le32 (get offset field))

select_action clauses:**t name:t > *t
let found fold clauses (nil *t) hit row clause
  if (text_eq (word clause 0) name) (case hit (some clause) dup (fail "duplicate_state_action")) hit
need found "missing_state_action" 0

branch_arrow terms:*t > i
let arrow fold terms -1 found row token if (text_eq token "->") (- row 1) found
if (< arrow 1) fail "expected_rule_arrow" arrow

rule_needs_meter rows:**t fields:i > b
let counts fold rows (pair 0 0) costs row terms
  if (or (eq row 1) (eq row (length rows))) costs
  let arrow branch_arrow terms
  let action_tokens - (length terms) (+ arrow 1)
  pair (+ (first costs) (- arrow 1)) (if (> action_tokens (second costs)) action_tokens (second costs))
let out_terms need (at rows (- (length rows) 1)) "expected_rule_output" 0
let per_event + (length out_terms) (+ (first counts) (second counts))
> (+ (+ 4100 fields) (* 4096 per_event)) 100000

branch_actions tokens:*t start:i slots:*{StateSlot} bindings:*{ScalarBinding} metered:b > t
let pieces fold tokens (pair (list *t 0) (list t 0)) state_value row token
  if (not (> row start)) state_value
  if (text_eq token ",") (pair (append (first state_value) (second state_value)) (list t 0))
  pair (first state_value) (append (second state_value) token)
let clauses append (first pieces) (second pieces)
if (not (eq (length clauses) (length slots))) fail "expected_all_state_actions"
fold slots "" code row field
  let clause select_action clauses (get name field)
  let mode word clause 2
  if (not (text_eq (word clause 1) "=")) fail "expected_state_action"
  let value if (text_eq mode "set") (scalar_expression clause 3 bindings (get kind field) metered true)
    (if (not (eq (length clause) 3)) (fail "invalid_state_action")
     if (text_eq mode "reset") (get initial field) (if (text_eq mode "keep") (state_load field) (fail "invalid_state_action")))
  concat code (concat (if metered tick_code "") (concat value (concat "498980" (le32 (get offset field)))))

compile_rule_block rule_decl:{Declaration} > {RuleProgram}
let signature words (get header rule_decl)
if (not (and (eq (length signature) 5) (text_eq (word signature 3) ">"))) fail "expected_scalar_rule"
let param typed_name (word signature 2)
let input_kind scalar_type (second param)
let output_kind scalar_type (word signature 4)
let rows fold (get body rule_decl) (list *t 0) tokens row line append tokens (words line)
let n length rows
if (< n 3) fail "incomplete_rule"
let slots state_slots (need (at rows 0) "expected_state_fields" 0)
let metered rule_needs_meter rows (length slots)
let bindings fold slots (list {ScalarBinding} 1 (scalar_binding (first param) input_kind "488b06")) acc row field
  append acc (scalar_binding (get name field) (get kind field) (state_load field))
let init fold slots "" code row field concat code (concat (get initial field) (concat "498987" (le32 (get offset field))))
let output_terms need (at rows (- n 1)) "expected_rule_output" 0
if (not (text_eq (word output_terms 0) "out")) fail "expected_rule_output"
let output scalar_expression output_terms 1 bindings output_kind metered true
let transition fold rows "" tail row unused
  let index - n row
  if (or (eq index 0) (eq index (- n 1))) tail
  let terms need (at rows index) "expected_rule_branch" 0
  let arrow branch_arrow terms
  let actions branch_actions terms (+ arrow 1) slots bindings metered
  if (eq index (- n 2))
    (if (and (eq arrow 1) (text_eq (word terms 0) "else")) actions (fail "expected_final_else"))
  if (not (text_eq (word terms 0) "when")) fail "expected_when"
  conditional (scalar_expression (word_range terms 1 arrow) 0 bindings "b" metered true) actions tail
make RuleProgram fields (length slots) code (make ScanCode input_kind input_kind output_kind output_kind
  state_bytes (* 8 (length slots)) metered metered init init transition transition output output)

find_rule blocks:*{Declaration} name:t > {Declaration}
let found fold blocks (nil {Declaration}) hit row decl
  let header words (get header decl)
  if (and (text_eq (word header 0) "rule") (text_eq (word header 1) name))
    (case hit (some decl) dup (fail "ambiguous_native_rule")) hit
need found "unknown_native_rule" 0

scan_values tokens:*t kind:t > &it
let grouped text_eq (word tokens 0) "("
let start if grouped 1 0
let stop - (length tokens) (if grouped 1 0)
if (and grouped (not (text_eq (word tokens stop) ")"))) fail "invalid_list_group"
if (not (and (text_eq (word tokens start) "list") (text_eq (word tokens (+ start 1)) kind))) fail "expected_literal_event_list"
let count need (int (word tokens (+ start 2))) "expected_list_length" 0
if (or (< count 0) (or (> count 4096) (not (eq count (- stop (+ start 3)))))) fail "wrong_list_length"
pair count (fold (word_range tokens (+ start 3) stop) "" data row token concat data (literal_bits kind token))

scan_program blocks:*{Declaration} entry:{Declaration} > t
let sig words (get header entry)
let dynamic eq (length sig) 4
if (not (or dynamic (eq (length sig) 3))) fail "expected_scan_entry"
let expr body_words entry
let direct text_eq (word expr 0) "scan"
let target if direct entry (find_declaration blocks (word expr 0))
let scan_terms if direct expr (body_words target)
if (not (text_eq (word scan_terms 0) "scan")) fail "expected_scan_body"
let rule_value compile_rule_block (find_rule blocks (word scan_terms 1))
let code get code rule_value
let list_type concat "*" (get input_kind code)
let args_at if direct 2 1
let args word_range expr args_at (length expr)
if (not direct)
  (let ts words (get header target)
   if (not (and (eq (length ts) 4) (and (eq (length scan_terms) 3)
      (text_eq (word ts 1) (concat (word scan_terms 2) (concat ":" list_type)))))) fail "expected_forwarded_event_list"
   scan_entry_image code (get fields rule_value) sig args dynamic false)
  (scan_entry_image code (get fields rule_value) sig args dynamic true)

scan_entry_image code:{ScanCode} fields:i sig:*t args:*t dynamic:b direct:b > t

method.compare:
import hashlib,json,os,random,statistics,subprocess as sp,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
w=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(); repo=Path.cwd(); os.sched_setaffinity(0,{2})
data={}
for name, param in [('pump','levels'),('light','events')]:
    old=w/'metered'/name; new=w/name; rows=[]
    for rep in range(-8,40):
        rng=random.Random(2424000+rep)
        vs=[rng.randrange(-25,126) if name=='pump' else rng.random()<.25 for _ in range(4096)]
        args=[('true' if v else 'false') if type(v)==bool else str(v) for v in vs]
        ref=sp.run([repo/'tide','run',repo/'apps'/(name+'.tide'),'--call','simulate','--inputs',json.dumps({param:vs},separators=(',',':'))],check=True,capture_output=True)
        expected=(json.dumps(json.loads(ref.stdout),separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode()
        order=['counted','bound'] if rep%2==0 else ['bound','counted']
        ns={}
        for mode in order:
            cmd=[old if mode=='counted' else new,*args]
            start=time.perf_counter_ns(); p=sp.run(cmd,capture_output=True); ns[mode]=time.perf_counter_ns()-start
            assert (p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr)==(0,expected,b'')
        rows.append(dict(rep=rep,first=order[0],**ns))
    kept=[r for r in rows if r['rep']>=0]
    data[name]=dict(counted_sha=hashlib.sha256(old.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),bound_sha=hashlib.sha256(new.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),counted_bytes=old.stat().st_size,bound_bytes=new.stat().st_size,rows=rows,wins=sum(r['counted']>r['bound'] for r in kept),median_ns_saved=statistics.median(r['counted']-r['bound'] for r in kept),median_ratio=statistics.median(r['counted']/r['bound'] for r in kept))
    print(name,data[name]['wins'],data[name]['median_ns_saved'],data[name]['median_ratio'],flush=True)
(w/'paired.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')
